PS99/1: Operational resilience for test firms

Timeline widget text

We set out final rules requiring test firms to identify their important business services. Read PS99/1 (PDF)

Who this applies to

This policy statement is relevant to all test firms we regulate.

What firms must do

  • Identify each important business service by 31 March 2027.
  • Set an impact tolerance for each one.
MilestoneDate
Rules in force31 March 2027
